card.name: Inside neuro and mito terms
card.fires_on: Responds to a short piece in the middle of a medical term or acronym, such as the 'rom' in neuromuscular or the M opening an acronym in parentheses. Also fires on 'to' or 'of' after depression or progress in overdose descriptions.

modes.label: Partway through neuro words
modes.description: The piece 'rom' or a capital N inside neuromuscular or Central Nervous System.
modes.example: neu<<rom>>uscular blocking action of skeletal muscle relax

modes.label: First letter of an acronym
modes.description: The M that opens an acronym in parentheses, such as MATE or MELAS.

modes.label: Link words in overdose text
modes.description: The word 'to' or 'of' after depression or progressing, in descriptions of overdose effects.
modes.example: somnolence progressing<< to>> stupor or coma, skeletal muscle fl
